clue.text: Everyone is punctual in due course

parts.note: everyone means all
to be punctual is to arrive early enough, with time to spare

explanation.surface: Everyone will be on time eventually, a reassurance about a late party.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases mean eventually, when the proper moment comes.

clue.text: Authority's abuse of freedom

explanation.surface: Those in power misuse liberty.
explanation.definitionFit: A permit is official authority to act; excessive liberty, as in poetic or wanton freedom, is also this word.

clue.text: I love getting a thank-you letter

parts.note: love is nil in tennis scoring, shaped like the letter O
ta is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: Someone is delighted to receive a note of thanks in the post.
explanation.definitionFit: The ninth character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: She's worshipped by a man in the gallery

definitions.text: She's worshipped by a man in the gallery

parts.words: She's worshipped by a man in the gallery
parts.note: the gallery of a theatre is 'the gods', so a female deity is fittingly adored by someone up there

explanation.surface: An admirer gazes at a woman from the art gallery or the theatre balcony.
explanation.walkthrough: The cheapest top seats in a British theatre are called 'the gods', so a man up there is among the gods.
explanation.definitionFit: A female deity is an object of worship.

clue.text: Beaten, due to no preparation

indicators.note: preparation means making ready, here working these letters into new form

explanation.surface: Someone lost because they did not prepare.
explanation.definitionFit: Surpassed by a rival, defeated.

clue.text: Record is broken by the winner

explanation.surface: A champion breaks the record.
explanation.definitionFit: Recording on magnetic strip; and the ribbon across a finish line that the first runner breasts.

clue.text: Sailor's fate under his superior

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits under the first one

parts.note: a mate is an officer above an ordinary seaman
one's lot is one's fate

explanation.surface: A seaman's destiny is decided by the officer above him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under' places LOT beneath MATE in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British term for a seaman, from French.

clue.text: Air force degrees?

parts.note: not RAF ranks but the graded measure of wind strength

explanation.surface: A question about qualifications or ranks in the RAF.
explanation.definitionFit: The scale grades wind strength from calm to hurricane.

clue.text: Punishing sort of diet

parts.note: the meagre fare given to prisoners as a penalty

explanation.surface: A harsh slimming regime.
explanation.definitionFit: Minimal prison rations, traditionally given as a penalty.

clue.text: Former spouse called, agitated

parts.note: an ex is a former husband or wife
called as a witness is cited

explanation.surface: An ex-partner phoned, causing distress.
explanation.definitionFit: Stirred up, worked up emotionally.

clue.text: He will have marked cards, of course

definitions.text: He will have marked cards, of course

parts.words: He will have marked cards, of course
parts.note: racecards at a racecourse annotated with predicted winners, not a cheat's playing cards

explanation.surface: A card sharp is naturally carrying a doctored deck.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing pundit who recommends horses to back.

clue.text: Vessels of the Navy in America

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other here

parts.note: US is short for the United States
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: Ships of the US Navy.
explanation.definitionFit: Containers, such as vases or tea urns.

clue.text: Determined to get the money back

indicators.note: back tells us the word for money is read the other way round

parts.note: banknotes are money

explanation.surface: Someone resolved to recover a debt.
explanation.definitionFit: Being set on something is being resolved to have it.

clue.text: Leaf-destroying parasite

indicators.note: destroying means wrecking the word leaf so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pest that ruins foliage.
explanation.definitionFit: A small jumping insect that lives on blood.

clue.text: HQ of the French vessel

parts.note: de is French for of
a pot is a container

explanation.surface: Headquarters of a French ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A base where stores or troops are kept, a headquarters.

clue.text: Needlewoman eliminates waste

explanation.surface: A seamstress clears up the rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: One who stitches; and the drain that carries effluent away.

clue.text: No sense spoiling unanimity

indicators.note: spoiling means ruining, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: It is pointless to wreck agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: Unity, being of one mind.

clue.text: Choose artist with complex personality

parts.note: to choose is to elect
RA is a Royal Academician

explanation.surface: Selecting a painter with a complicated character.
explanation.walkthrough: The Electra complex is a Freudian term, so she is a personality with a complex.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek tragic heroine gives her name to a psychoanalytic complex.

clue.text: Swimmer who may develop into a jumper

definitions.text: Swimmer who may develop into a jumper

parts.words: Swimmer who may develop into a jumper
parts.note: a larva in the water that grows into a leaping frog, not a knitted garment

explanation.surface: A swimmer who might switch to long jump.
explanation.definitionFit: The larval stage of a frog, living in water before metamorphosis.

clue.text: In such rain, it's better than walking

definitions.text: In such rain, it's better than walking

parts.words: In such rain, it's better than walking
parts.note: heavy wind-blown rain is described by the same word as travelling by car

explanation.surface: In a downpour it is best to take the car.
explanation.definitionFit: Driving rain is heavy rain; driving is going by car.

clue.text: Speak fast

explanation.surface: Talk quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: To voice something; and a fast train or delivery.

clue.text: An enquiry agent, of course

parts.note: an official at a racecourse who holds inquiries, not a private detective

explanation.surface: A private detective, naturally.
explanation.walkthrough: Racecourse officials hold a 'stewards' enquiry' into incidents in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing official who adjudicates disputes at a meeting.

clue.text: Great is possibly used to describe Britain

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: Great is the adjective for Britain, as in Great Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Surrounded by ocean, as the island nation is poetically described.

clue.text: Is a name recollectable? Not with this

definitions.text: Is a name recollectable? Not with this

indicators.note: re-collectable, able to be gathered again in another order

explanation.surface: Can you recall a name? Not if you have this condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollectable' read as re-collectable rearranges IS A NAME; the whole clue also describes memory loss.
explanation.definitionFit: Loss of memory makes names impossible to recall.

clue.text: Told off when offspring left abandoned

indicators.note: abandoned means dropped, so a letter is removed

parts.note: a child is offspring

explanation.surface: Scolded when the kid was deserted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' removes L from CHILD; CHID is an old past tense of chide.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic past tense of chide, scolded.

clue.text: Traps specially designed for small fish

indicators.note: specially designed means made in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fishing gear made for catching minnows.
explanation.definitionFit: A small herring-like food fish.

clue.text: A list of female Christian names will include it

definitions.text: A list of female Christian names will include it

indicators.note: will include says the words just before contain the answer within them

explanation.surface: A register of girls' names would contain this one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will include' marks christiAN NAmes; read whole, the clue also says any roll of girls' first names contains this one.
explanation.definitionFit: A common woman's first name.

clue.text: High spot for tourists in Japan?

definitions.text: High spot for tourists in Japan?

parts.words: High spot for tourists in Japan?
parts.note: a highlight of a trip, literally a tall mountain there

explanation.surface: The best moment of a holiday in Japan.
explanation.definitionFit: Japan's highest mountain, a popular sight for visitors.

clue.text: Perhaps every school holds a recess

indicators.note: holds means the clue words contain the answer within them

explanation.surface: Probably all schools have a break time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holds' marks perhAPS Every; recess is a church alcove here, not a school break.
explanation.definitionFit: A vaulted semicircular alcove at the end of a church.

clue.text: The rest of one's days

parts.note: not the remainder of life but the relaxation time in each day

explanation.surface: The remainder of a lifetime.
explanation.definitionFit: Free time for relaxation, rest from work.

clue.text: I'm old fashioned, there's no getting away from it

definitions.text: there's no getting away from it

parts.note: passé means out of date

explanation.surface: A speaker admits to being out of date, and is stuck with it.
explanation.definitionFit: A deadlock, a situation with no way out.

clue.text: What stealing a product is?

parts.note: a pun reading theft of a manufactured item as obtaining a gain, which is criminal

explanation.surface: A question about the legality of shoplifting.
explanation.definitionFit: Illegal, prohibited by statute.
